question: If the mode of a data exceeds its mean by 16.2, then the mode exceeds the median by _______. (Use empirical formula to find the answer.)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

From the empirical formula, the differences between Mode, Median, and Mean always follow a fixed 2 : 1 ratio.

⇒ (Mode − Median) : (Median − Mean) = 2 : 1

⇒ Total difference (Mode − Mean) = 3 parts = 16.2

⇒ 1 part = 16.2 ÷ 3 = 5.4

⇒ Mode − Median = 2 parts = 2 × 5.4 = 10.8

**∴ The correct answer is 10.8.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Mode − Mean = 16.2

**Formula Used:**

Empirical formula: Mode = 3 × Median − 2 × Mean

 
•

 Total Difference = 3 parts = 16.2

**Calculations:**

⇒ Mode − Mean = 16.2

⇒ Mean = Mode − 16.2

Substituting Mean in the empirical formula:

⇒ Mode = 3 × Median − 2 × (Mode − 16.2)

⇒ Mode = 3 × Median − 2 × Mode + 32.4

⇒ Mode + 2 × Mode = 3 × Median + 32.4

⇒ 3 × Mode = 3 × Median + 32.4

⇒ 3 × (Mode − Median) = 32.4

⇒ Mode − Median = 32.4 ÷ 3

⇒ Mode − Median = 10.8

**∴ The correct answer is 10.8.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Empirical Relationship

For a moderately skewed distribution, the relationship between Mean, Median, and Mode is given by: Mode = 3 × Median − 2 × Mean.

Mean (Average)

It is the sum of all observations divided by the total number of observations. It is highly affected by extreme values.

Median

It is the middlemost value of a sorted data set. It divides the distribution into two equal halves and is not affected by extreme outliers.

Mode

It is the value that appears most frequently in a data set. A data set may have one mode, multiple modes, or no mode at all.
